topics.topic_title: Common Landlord Tax Mistakes That Trigger an HMRC Enquiry
topics.search_intent: Landlords fearful of the taxman want a plain-English list of the errors and red flags that get rental income flagged, plus how to stay clean. Brand-warmth / reassurance intent.

demand.query: how to avoid capital gains tax on rental property

topics.suggested_angle: Warmth round-up: the 10 most common rental-tax mistakes (under-declaring deposits/retained rent, wrong capital-vs-revenue split, missing the s24 restriction, claiming pre-letting costs incorrectly, forgetting jointly-owned splits) and the behaviours that draw HMRC attention. Internal-link out to nudge-letter playbook, Let Property Campaign, discovery-assessment pages.

topics.topic_title: Landlord Tax Myths Debunked (What You've Been Told That Is Wrong)
topics.search_intent: Landlords acting on second-hand pub/forum advice want common misconceptions corrected (e.g. 'I can deduct all my mortgage', 'gifting to my spouse dodges CGT', 'I don't need to declare a one-room let'). High brand-warmth.

demand.query: can i avoid capital gains tax if i give the money to my spouse

topics.closest_our_page: fic-iht-treatment-bpr-myth (single niche FIC/BPR myth only; no broad landlord-myth hub)
topics.suggested_angle: Myth-vs-reality format covering the most repeated landlord tax myths. Pair the spouse/CGT myth (gift of money vs gift of asset, no-gain-no-loss interspousal transfer) with mortgage-interest, rent-a-room, and 'cash rent is invisible' myths. Strong internal linking to s24, CGT-spouse-transfer, and Let Property Campaign pages.
